story: A pnpm workspace: every package's tsconfig extends one reached through a node_modules symlink. Before the lift the link dangled inside the sandbox, scip-typescript failed on every zone (TS6053), and the whole repo fell to lane A's syntactic floor. The per-directory view is what named the fix.
caption: Same repo, same commit, two Hobbes builds. Before: the contained ingest could not follow the workspace link, so lane B answered nowhere and capture read 0.1% — a number the per-directory view exposed as one failure repeated per zone, not fifteen small ones. After C-74 (workspace node_modules links mount their targets, and an indexer's exit is told from the helper's) and C-90 (a zone's stage carries every config its tsconfig names), fifteen of fifteen zones index. Every workspace-aware tool meets this shape; the point of the picture is that the failure was visible per directory before it was fixed.
